name: Coarse-to-fine feature grid
aliases: Coarse-to-fine feature grid — Progressive Upscaling of Feature Grids
definition: A training optimization scheme that reduces initial training cost and regularizes matrices and vectors by initializing a 3D feature grid at a coarse resolution and progressively upscaling it to higher resolutions.
summary: A training optimization scheme that reduces cost by initializing a 3D feature grid at coarse resolution and progressively upscaling it, unlike static methods.
